questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: Let \(P(n)\) be a statement for each natural number \(n\). Assume that \(P(n+1)\) is a true statement whenever \(P(n)\) is a true statement. Suppose \(P(2018)\) is true. Then which one of the following statements is true?
options: \(P(n)\) is true for exactly two values of \(n\).
\(P(n)\) is false for at most finitely many values of \(n\).
\(P(n)\) is false for infinitely many values of \(n\).
